present.label: Read the slogan
present.story: The slogan has {n} characters. Compare the outermost letters and work inward.
present.formal: len(text) = {n}. Compare text[left] with text[right], skipping characters that are not alphanumeric.

initialize.label: Start at both ends
initialize.story: One finger on the first character (position {left}) and one on the last (position {right}).

skip-left.label: Skip on the left
skip-left.story: Position {index} is {char}, which doesn't count. The left finger steps past it without comparing.

skip-right.label: Skip on the right
skip-right.story: Position {index} is {char}, which doesn't count. The right finger steps past it without comparing.

match.label: Compare
match.story: {leftChar} and {rightChar} are the same letter once capitals are ignored. This pair mirrors.

step-inward.label: Move both inward
step-inward.story: Both fingers step inward, to positions {left} and {right}.

mismatch.label: Mismatch
mismatch.story: {leftChar} and {rightChar} differ, so the slogan doesn't read the same backwards. No cookie today.

palindrome.label: Reads both ways
palindrome.story: The fingers have met and every pair mirrored. Pairs matched: {pairs}. Free cookie!
palindrome.formal: left >= right after {pairs} matched pairs. Return True.
